change: Add the Dewy 3d starter with a physics character, crates, ray-cast orb selection, generated meshes/sound and a headless project test. Reset mouse deltas on capture transitions and discard the browser capture warp before pointerlockchange.
validation: Independent C bootstrap: 27 focused starter, camera and pointer-lock checks passed in 10.28s. Ruff, formatter and git diff --check passed.
coverage: Native/web, default/release: nearest visible orb, wall limit, sphere surface before center, missed/behind/collected orbs, origin inside orb, view direction and bobbing.
Physics world and character: floor, jumping, wall collision, ray fraction, impulse, removal and saved-world independence.
Generated native software render and web build; included headless project test in both native modes.
Actual JS handlers under Node: transition notifications before/after mouse events, no warp delta, subsequent real motion preserved, unchanged lock notifications, button events.

Manual Chromium browser: pointer capture preserves yaw=0/pitch=0 (previously snapped to yaw=1.6/pitch=1.0); relative aiming works, shooting a visible orb increments count to 1/8, Escape releases capture.
limits: Browser used SwiftShader software rendering. Full-resolution smoke rendered correctly but became sluggish and one screenshot timed out; interaction verification used a 640x400 framebuffer with a diagnostic copy of the starter. No hardware browser frame-rate claim.
Physical gamepad and native desktop pointer capture were not exercised.
Keyboard movement/jump logic is verified by deterministic native/web physics checks; browser inputs were sent but no separate browser trajectory assertion is claimed.
